teaser: The room is choir practice, voices settling into one note before the director lifts a hand. You are life path 6, the number of the one who notices who hasn't arrived yet, and you are an ENFP, the type that lights up the whole room the moment it walks in. The 6 wants a hearth and a steady hand on it; the ENFP wants doors left open and new songs tried. Crossed, you get someone who can build a home out of enthusiasm itself, if the enthusiasm doesn't wander off before the roof goes on.
excerpt: The campsite lantern keeps flickering, and you're the one who gets up to fix it while everyone else stays in their sleeping bags, because leaving it broken feels worse than losing an hour of sleep.
